page_title: MON 1-2 DOR | B. Monchengladbach v Dortmund 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90+8' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
90+7' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call.
90+4' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
90+2' What a chance that is! Franck Honorat swings the ball into the box, and Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
90+2' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+1' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90+1' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
87' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

87' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jonas Omlin with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
85' The game is interrupted as Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is flagged offside.
85' Problems for Gerardo Seoane as Jordan Siebatcheu is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) replaces him.
84' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
82' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Gregor Kobel.
79' A player from B. Monchengladbach commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
77' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) is coming onto the pitch as Maximilian Wober cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' A substitution has been made. Julian Weigl goes off and Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
71' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Mats Hummels (Dortmund) replaces Youssoufa Moukoko.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) for Julian Brandt.
70' B. Monchengladbach are ruled offside.
70' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Surely that's handball by one of the Dortmund players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
68' An attempted cross from Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
67' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
67' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
65' The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach win a corner kick.
64' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Stefan Lainer and he is replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nathan Ngoumou walks off the pitch to be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
63' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
62' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) sends a chip pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel is quickest to intercept the ball.
55' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is dismissed from the pitch after receiving his second caution today. He can take an early bath.
55' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens will be replaced by Donyell Malen (Dortmund).
54' The Dortmund players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Florian Badstubner. NO PENALTY!
53' Celebrations by Dortmund are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
49' Goal! Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jonas Omlin into the bottom left corner.
49' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
48' The game is interrupted. One of the players from B. Monchengladbach is cautioned for aggressive play. PENALTY to Dortmund!
46' Edin Terzic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Julian Ryerson comes on the pitch for Ian Maatsen (Dortmund).
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund). Florian Badstubner doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+3' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' The shot by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Jonas Omlin.
44' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
41' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
39' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Gregor Kobel pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
38' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) was too forceful with his tackle and Florian Badstubner interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

36' 1 - 2 Goal! Franck Honorat sent a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:2.
36' The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
35' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Dortmund was in an offside position.
35' Florian Badstubner couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle.
33' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
30' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
28' 0 - 2 Goal! Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jonas Omlin into the bottom right corner.
28' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' One of the B. Monchengladbach players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Dortmund are awarded a penalty kick!
27' Poor challenge! Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for tripping and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Dortmund.
26' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Gregor Kobel comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' 0 - 1 Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) collects a well-executed cross inside the box and coolly slots the ball into the top right corner.
21' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
21' Half-chance! Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) plays a pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
20' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
19' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner but it's cleared.
17' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) brings an opponent down and Florian Badstubner interrupts the game.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.
10' Sebastien Haller is being substituted because of an injury. Edin Terzic sends Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) on the pitch.
7' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
5' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach).
5' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Dortmund have a corner.
5' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Dortmund.
3' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.

The players are out at last! Dortmund will take the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is the one to supervise the game today.
